title: chore: release polli 0.1.25, sdk 5.1.0-alpha.8 and ui 0.1.0-alpha.4
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Bumps `@pollinations/cli` 0.1.24 → 0.1.25 to publish #16279 and #16292, which merged after 0.1.24 went to npm
- Bumps `@pollinations/sdk` 5.1.0-alpha.7 → 5.1.0-alpha.8 (dist-tag `alpha`) to publish the 11 SDK PRs merged since alpha.7 was published on 2026-09-08, including #16347, #16352 and #16354; adds the changelog entry
- Bumps `@pollinations/ui` 0.1.0-alpha.3 → 0.1.0-alpha.4 (dist-tag `alpha`) to publish the 16 UI commits merged since 2026-09-23
- `release-publish-npm-packages.yml` publishes all three on merge to main; nothing else changes

Checked locally: all three build; SDK and UI typecheck; tests SDK 117/117, CLI 283/283, UI 94/94.

gist.headline: Three fresh seed packets
gist.blurb: Polli, the SDK, and the UI each get a fresh package version. The code was already in the garden; this puts it in the seed packets developers install.
gist.summary: Updates @pollinations/cli from 0.1.24 to 0.1.25, @pollinations/sdk from 5.1.0-alpha.7 to alpha.8, and @pollinations/ui from 0.1.0-alpha.3 to alpha.4, packaging changes merged since their previous npm releases.
gist.impact: Developers get the CLI changes from #16279 and #16292, 11 additional SDK PRs, and 16 UI commits through the updated package versions.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the three npm packages as labeled seed packets—CLI beside a terminal, SDK beside code, and UI beside a little window—ready for planting in a cozy code garden. Polli tends the packets with a tiny gardening hat; the package names and versions are the useful visual details, with no invented package mascots.
